args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

With `ROUND_HALF_UP`, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returns `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch import and quantize call from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/banker-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
